long_biography.plain_text:
Laurens Patisseries founder Dion Liveras learnt the food trade inside his family's earlier business, Fleur de Lys. He joined at eighteen and spent seven years learning its operations before becoming managing director. He subsequently oversaw its acquisition by Grand Metropolitan, gaining experience of both running and selling a substantial food business.

At Alysia Caring, Liveras holds shares and directorships in companies providing residential and nursing care. He controls its Stamford business, while financing from L&A Finance, another company under his control, has supported the development of care properties. He is also a qualified pilot and speaks English and Greek.
